question:
Select the option in which the numbers are NOT related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(192, 140, 252)
solution: The Logic followed here is: **Square of any number - 4 = number** **For **(192, 140, 252) [IMAGE: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/14.0/2705/72.png] (14)² - 4 = 192; (12)2 - 4 = 140 (16)² - 4 = 252; Option 1: (165, 140, 192) [IMAGE: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/14.0/2705/72.png] (13)² - 4 = 165 (12)2 - 4 = 140 (14)2 - 4 = 192; Option 2: (221, 192, 252) [IMAGE: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/14.0/2705/72.png] (15)2 - 4 = 221; (14)2 - 4 = 192; (16)2 - 4 = 252; **Option 3: (186, 134, 246) ** [IMAGE: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/14.0/274c/72.png] **(14)2 - 4 = 192 ≠ 186** **(12)2 - 4 = 140 ≠ 134** **(16)2 - 4 = 252 ≠ 246** Option 4: (165, 117, 221) [IMAGE: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/14.0/2705/72.png] (13)2 - 4 = 165 (11)2 - 4 = 117 (15)2 - 4 = 221; But this pattern is not applicable in** option C.** So, this pattern is not applicable. 97:T1bf0,
